generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical Contractor License issued from Public Work Department or Inspectorate of Electricity
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate.
List of ongoing and existing works

Tenderer in their name should submit annual turnover certificate any two years from last five years of Rs.3.65 Lakhs in each year.The turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

The Tenderer should have at least executed and satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one Such SIMILAR Electrical work for amount not less than Rs 1.82Lakhs as in any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU in Last Five Years
